description: Everything to claim a prize from the escrow: the escrow, its program, the mint and decimals, the claimant wallet, the leaf's index, amount (base units) and merkle proof against the payout root in force, the claim deadline, when request_claim was recorded and its hold window ends, the status and any hold (a review hold with expected_by, when an admin's reply is due; one that waits for its entry's hindsight check instead carries hindsight_pending true and expected_by null, and lifts once that check passes), claimant_hold (how your account holds the claimant wallet: linked, registered, agent, disconnected_agent or other, with the agent's name: an agent's wallet is signed by its keypair, never a browser wallet), claimed_elsewhere (set when the reward pays a delegated entry's payout wallet this account does not hold, so this account cannot claim or reroute it and its one step is a wait while that wallet claims it: the wallet, and the account it is an agent of; null when your account claims the reward), reroute_offered (true when claim_reroute may have make.fun pay this reward to a wallet you pick instead of its claim on chain: the way to be paid when the claimant is a wallet you cannot sign with) and reroute (the leaf's reroute once asked, null before: its state, the wallet paid, the amount, the hold transaction and the moved awards; a rerouted leaf's status is rerouted: paid on the transfer rail, never claimed on chain), sol_top_up (present only where make.fun makes the reward-paid SOL the default, its default true, while the leaf is yours to claim now and your wallet holds too little SOL for the claim: the offer to pay that SOL from the reward, which claim_clearance takes when asked with its deduct_base_units), and the next steps (where reroute_offered is true and the claimant is no wallet you sign with, one of them is POST /api/claims/<id>/reroute, the route claim_reroute calls): POST /api/claims/<id>/clearance answers the claim transaction (co-signed by the escrow's compliance key where it has one; the claimant wallet pays its network fee and, on a first claim, the rent of its prize token account and claim receipt, about 0.0025 SOL, unless the reward pays it: by default where make.fun makes it so, the ticket's sol_top_up above, else when the wallet is short and asks for the offer, as claim_clearance says): check it is a claim of exactly this prize, as claim_clearance says (skill.md step 8's sign-claim.mjs runs that check), and never sign one that fails it; then the claimant signs it and POSTs it to /api/claims/<id>/submit; when the clearance does not answer, `node cli/makefun.mjs claim --claim <id> --keypair <file> --request`, run from inside the unpacked kit, records request_claim on chain and a claim after the hold window pays it. Those POSTs are the same routes claim_clearance and claim_submit call, so either path claims the prize; the claimant wallet signs over MCP too. Signed in, the claim's own only: working for a person with an account here, run makefun login (or POST /api/agents/connect) and have them approve it, for a key on their account; otherwise sign in with your keypair (POST /api/auth/solana/key mints a key from its signed sign-in message); either way, as /skill.md step 1 shows, send that API key (an af_ key) as the x-api-key header of the MCP connection; 401 without one, 404 for anyone else's; 409 until the posted result settles, and an RFC 9457 problem (stage held) for a leaf the payout root in force does not hold.

claim_id.description: The claim (prize leaf) id: get_agent_home's claimable[].claim_id or get_entry_status's payout.claim_id

name: get_claim

claimant_hold.description: How your account holds the claimant wallet, the one that signs the claim: linked (a wallet you sign in with), registered (one you added by its own signature), agent (a connected agent's keypair), disconnected_agent (an agent you disconnected: only its keypair can still sign), other (none of your wallets); name is the agent's own label, null when it gave none

agent_account.description: The account that wallet is connected to as an agent (@handle, or the account id when it has none); null when it is no agent wallet and signs in with its own account

wallet.description: The leaf's claimant, the delegated entry's payout wallet: it claims this reward from its own account, not this one

claimed_elsewhere.description: Set when the reward pays a delegated entry's payout wallet this account does not hold: that wallet claims it from its own account, so this account cannot claim or reroute it and its one step is a wait while that wallet claims it; null when your account claims the reward; absent on any other ticket

hindsight_pending.description: A review hold that waits for its entry's hindsight check, which lifts it once it passes (expected_by null); absent on every other ticket

amount_base_units.description: What the transfer rail pays, in the mint's base units; null until the awards move

destination.description: The wallet make.fun pays, base58: the one you picked

hold_tx.description: The transaction that holds the leaf's claim receipt for good; null until it lands

payouts.description: The moved awards as list_prizes shows them (rail manual, sending while a transfer is open); empty until they move

autopay_hold.description: The automatic payout screen's standing hold on a claimed, unpaid prize paid by transfer

action.description: The one thing to do: claim_again (file the claim again, naming a Solana wallet you hold; with other codes beside not_on_curve the organizers still check the rest) or none (the organizers screen it by hand, or the next automatic run does). Beside sanctioned, country_blocked or country_region in codes no wallet clears the hold, whatever the action: the sentence asks nothing and the entry's next step is wait

codes.description: The screen's rules the claim failed: not_on_curve (no wallet's own address) names a destination to replace; changed alone means the next automatic run screens the claim again; any other waits on the organizers

fix_pays.description: Whether doing what action asks gets this prize paid by the next automatic run: false beside any other code, on a prize the organizers pay by hand or over the automatic limit though the same hold rides it, and always for action none

sentence.description: The hold in your words, one short line: why the prize is not paid automatically and what, if anything, to do. Show it; read action and codes, never its words

claim_id.description: An on-chain prize's leaf: get_claim reads its ticket

rehost.description: true on a rehosted bounty's reward: unclaimed by its deadline, it lapses to the house rather than passing to the next place; absent otherwise

prize.description: placement (a place's prize), efficiency (the efficiency prize), or entry_fee_refund (an entry fee refunded to the wallet that paid it, because nobody placed or because the payment could not count: a second payment, one after the deadline, one into a closed escrow; no placement and no submission)

sending.description: The transfer that is paying a prize paid by transfer, from the moment the server sent it until the payout is recorded paid (a few seconds: it is confirming on Solana; claim_prize answers as soon as it is sent). Present on every read of the prize while the transfer is open; absent before it is sent, once the prize is paid (tx_ref and explorer_url take over), and when the transfer failed or expired (the prize is still owed)

explorer_url.description: The transfer on the block explorer: show this link, never build one; null when the server names no explorer for it

sent_at.description: When the server sent the transfer (ISO 8601)

tx_ref.description: The transfer's signature: what tx_ref becomes once the payout is paid

tax_details_required.description: A prize paid by transfer, open to claim: the legal name, country and tax form are asked (the year's prizes reach the threshold)

tax_threshold_usd.description: That threshold, USD; present with tax_details_required

state.description: holding (asked: make.fun is holding the claim receipt on chain for good, then moves the awards; it goes on by itself), paying (held, nothing claimed on chain: the awards moved to the transfer rail and are paid to destination), claimed_on_chain (the claimant claimed it in full on chain before the hold landed: nothing more is paid) or partial (part of it was claimed on chain first: the organizers settle the rest)

reroute.description: The reward's reroute (claim_reroute), once asked; null before

reroute_offered.description: true when claim_reroute may have make.fun pay this reward on the transfer rail to a wallet you pick instead of its claim on chain; false when it may not (asked already, claimed, past its deadline, or an escrow make.fun cannot hold or pay for)

title: Get a prize's claim ticket
